subject.title: fix: prevent unknown channel bindings from silently falling back

question: Should retired binding channel IDs hard-fail startup only once Doctor can migrate them automatically, or should this release retain a non-blocking diagnostic until that repair path exists?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes existing persisted routing configuration from silent fallback to fail-closed startup behavior; choosing the release/upgrade posture requires maintainer intent even though the migration implementation itself is narrow.

options.title: Add Doctor migration before hard-fail
options.body: Preserve the proposed canonical validation and add an idempotent Doctor repair with fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Warn temporarily
options.body: Emit an actionable warning for retired bindings until a tested Doctor migration can ship, avoiding an immediate startup block for existing installs.

recommendation.title: Add Doctor migration before hard-fail
recommendation.body: Preserve the proposed canonical validation and add an idempotent Doctor repair with fresh-install and upgrade proof.
